Chat request with custom stop sequences that terminates generation at a stop token

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"List items until you see STOP\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stop\":[\"STOP\",\"END\"]}")
IO.inspect(result.choices)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.choices, 0).finish_reason)
```
